hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: BuildMode
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: BuildAll 构建所有资源 BuildTbAndHotfix 构建表和代码 BuidHotfix 禁用 BuildTb 禁用

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: Macro
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: LY_COMMON 联运默认版本 OVERSEA 海外版本 LY_ZX 坠星大陆 LY_SZCX 深圳朝希 LY_BT_LZ 梨子专服 LY_BT BT版本 LY_BT_1Y BT一元版本 LY_BT_X7 bt小七 LY_BT_GO BTGO LY_SELF QuickSDK官网自发版本 LY_SELF_NOQG 非QuickGame版本 USE_CUSTOM_ACCOUNT 白包

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: IsBuildPkg
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: //构建安装包或者导出xcode或者webgl工程

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: PkgType
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: AllRes 安装包包含所有资源 NoRes安装包包含不包含资源 HalfRes安装包包含包含部分资源

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: OnlyBuildProject
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: 只编译工程，不重新导出

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: AbdetailVer
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: 1_1.0.0.1 坠星大陆 基础资源清单存放目录

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ABNameWithHash
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: 生成的补丁，ab资源名称是否需要待遇hash值，目前只有webgl需要勾选

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: OutputPath
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 导出路径（app工程导出路径）空值有代码指定

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: AssetLoadType
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: WEBGL首包资源存放在CDN：0, 本地：1

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET SVN_USERNAME=taigu1build SET SVN_USERPWD=123456 SET SVNEXE=svn.exe
if %SvnUpdateType% == None GOTO END_SVN_UDPATE if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateAndRevert GOTO SVN_UPDATE_AND_REVERT if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateNoRevert GOTO SVN_UPDATE_AND_NOTREVERT :SVN_UPDATE_AND_REVERT cd %PROJ_PATH% CALL %SVNEXE% cleanup --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% CALL %SVNEXE% revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R . CALL %SVNEXE% update --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateAndRevert GOTO END_SVN_UDPATE :SVN_UPDATE_AND_NOTREVERT cd %PROJ_PATH% CALL %SVNEXE% cleanup --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% CALL %SVNEXE% update --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% echo "Update Done. `date`" :END_SVN_UDPATE
svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R %PROJ_PATH%\ProjectSettings
SET HOTFIX_LINKING=%PROJ_PATH%\Assets\hotfix SET HOTFIX_PROJ=%PROJ_PATH%\hotfix\hotfix\iLScript if %UseHotFix% == true ( RD /S /Q %HOTFIX_LINKING% GOTO END_LINK_HOTFIX ) if NOT exist %HOTFIX_LINKING% GOTO LINK_HOTFIX :LINK_HOTFIX REM RD /S /Q %HOTFIX_LINKING% MKLINK /J %HOTFIX_LINKING% %HOTFIX_PROJ% :END_LINK_HOTFIX
SETLOCAL enabledelayedexpansion
REM 重新导出as工程，则revert打包工程 if %OnlyBuildProject% == true GOTO EXPORT_AS_SUCCESS
if %Platform% == Android ECHO GOTO PLATFORM_ANDROID_AS_REVERT if %Platform% == WEBGL ECHO GOTO PLATFORM_WEBGL_PROJ_REVERT :PLATFORM_ANDROID_AS_REVERT if %BuildPkgType% == APKAndAAB GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_APK if %BuildPkgType% == APK GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_APK if %BuildPkgType% == AAB GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_AAB :REVERT_ASPROJ_APK SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH=!PROJ_PATH!\AndroidSDK\BuildModelProject svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! if %BuildPkgType% == APK GOTO END_REVERT_ASPROJ :REVERT_ASPROJ_AAB SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH=!PROJ_PATH!\AndroidSDK\BuildModelProject svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! :PLATFORM_WEBGL_PROJ_REVERT ECHO WEBGL PROJ REVERT ... :END_REVERT_ASPROJ ENDLOCAL
REM SET COMMON_LINKING=%PROJ_PATH%\Assets\Common REM SET COMMON_PROJ=%PROJ_PATH%\Common REM if NOT exist %COMMON_LINKING% GOTO LINK_COMMON REM :LINK_COMMON REM MKLINK /J %COMMON_LINKING% %COMMON_PROJ% REM DEL /A /F %PROJ_PATH%\Assets\Plugins\Common.dll REM DEL /A /F %PROJ_PATH%\Assets\Plugins\Common.dll.mdb

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
SETLOCAL enabledelayedexpansion

COPY /Y !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\NoInCommon\WRITE_PKG\strings.xml !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\src\MLQuick\res\values\strings.xml COPY /Y !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\NoInCommon\WRITE_PKG\build.gradle !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\build.gradle COPY /Y !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\NoInCommon\WRITE_PKG\ChannelMLQuick.java !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw\src\MLQuick\java\com\bingougame\sdk ) ECHO !ORGIN_APK_NAME! SET NEW_APK_NAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Macro%_%Identify%_%ResVer%_d%IsDebug%_v%UseHotFix%_t%IsABTest%.apk
REM ECHO RELEASE_DIR:!RELEASE_DIR! REM ECHO ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH:!ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! REM ECHO APK_DIR:!APK_DIR! REM ECHO NEW_APK_NAME:!NEW_APK_NAME! if %IsDebug% == false ( CD !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! CALL DEL /S /Q *.mdb CALL DEL /S /Q *.pdb )
REM COPY /Y !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\NoInCommon\TChinese\build.gradle !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! CD !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!
if %UseTgswOS% == true ( CALL G:\gradle-8.0\bin\gradle.bat clean CALL G:\gradle-8.0\bin\gradle.bat aR ) if %UseTgswOS% == false ( CALL gradle.bat clean CALL gradle.bat aR ) CD !APK_DIR! DIR ECHO !ORGIN_APK_NAME! !NEW_APK_NAME! ECHO %ORGIN_APK_NAME% %NEW_APK_NAME% REN !ORGIN_APK_NAME! !NEW_APK_NAME! COPY /Y !NEW_APK_NAME! !RELEASE_DIR! if %BuildPkgType% == APK GOTO END_BUILDPKG if %BuildPkgType% == APKAndAAB CALL TIMEOUT /T 5 /NOBREAK :BUILD_AAB SET ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH=%PROJ_PATH%\AndroidSDK\BuildModelProject\tgsw_google SET AAB_DIR=!ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\build\outputs\bundle\TChineseRelease SET ORGIN_APK_NAME=tgsw_google-TChinese-release.aab SET NEW_AAB_NAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_%PkgType%_%VersionName%_%VersionCode%.aab
if %IsDebug% == false ( CD !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\install_time_asset_pack\src\main\assets\bin\Data\Managed\ CALL DEL /S /Q *.mdb CALL DEL /S /Q *.pdb ) REM ECHO RELEASE_DIR:!RELEASE_DIR! REM ECHO ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH:!ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! REM ECHO AAB_DIR:!AAB_DIR! REM ECHO ORGIN_APK_NAME:!ORGIN_APK_NAME! REM ECHO NEW_AAB_NAME:!NEW_AAB_NAME!
CD !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH! CALL G:\gradle-8.0\bin\gradle.bat clean CALL G:\gradle-8.0\bin\gradle.bat bundleR
CD !AAB_DIR! ECHO !ORGIN_APK_NAME! !NEW_AAB_NAME! ECHO %ORGIN_APK_NAME% %NEW_AAB_NAME% REN !ORGIN_APK_NAME! !NEW_AAB_NAME! COPY /Y !NEW_AAB_NAME! !RELEASE_DIR! :PLATFORM_WEBGL_BUILD_PKG ECHO BEGIN BUILD...WEBGL... :END_BUILDPKG

CD !DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE! %ZIP_EXE% a %PATCH_NAME% -mx0 VersionInfo.txt Res UpdateInfo.txt REM COPY /Y *.zip !RELEASE_DIR! COPY /Y %PATCH_NAME% !RELEASE_DIR! :END_BUILD_PATCH ENDLOCAL
